title: Very Nice Quality, but wash only in cold water
text: Very Nice Quality, but wash only in cold water. Very nice quality, attractive tablecloth that is good enough for "company".  Seems quite durable.  The only downside to this is that even though it is machine washable, the instructions say to wash in cold water.  If you wash mostly in hot water (as I do), you will have to put this separately in a cold water batch of laundry.  Other than the laundering restriction, I think you will be very happy with this table cloth.  It is not thin, cheap material that will wear out fast or tear.  It is a quality made item.  Made in India according to the label.  Looks good without ironing.
